description: This file defines a LightningJS component named 'RecipeDetailModal' that serves as a modal dialog to display detailed information about a recipe, including image, tags, ingredients, steps, and favorite toggle functionality.

classes.name: RecipeDetailModal
classes.description: LightningJS component for rendering a detailed modal view of a recipe, with props for visibility, recipe data, and favorited status, along with computed properties and methods for interaction.

methods.name: $close
methods.description: Emits a 'close' event to signal that the modal should close.

methods.name: $toggleFav
methods.description: Emits a 'toggleFavorite' event with the current recipe's ID to toggle its favorite status.
